title: Affine Yangians as Limits of Quantum Toroidal Algebras
summary: We establish a degeneration isomorphism between quantum toroidal algebras and untwisted affine Yangians, valid for all untwisted affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras. Specifically, we prove that the affine Yangian $Y_\hbar(\mathfrak{g})$ is isomorphic, as a $\mathbb{C}[\hbar]$-algebra, to the associated graded algebra of the quantum toroidal algebra $U_\hbar(\mathfrak{g}^{\mathrm{tor}})$ with respect to a canonical filtration.
